identification.description: Evergreen fir with flattened linear leaves and erect cones; the aromatic leaves are the traditional drug part.
identification.whole_plant: Large evergreen conifer with conical crown.
identification.stem: Straight trunk with greyish bark and spreading branches.
identification.leaf: Flat linear needle-like leaves arranged on twigs; aromatic when crushed.
identification.flower: Male and female reproductive structures occur as cones rather than showy flowers.
identification.fruit: Cones are erect, cylindrical and disintegrate at maturity; typical fir cone character.
identification.seed: Winged conifer seeds associated with mature cones.

therapeutics.precautions: Correct botanical identity is essential because conifer leaves can be confused with other species.

phytochemistry.chemical_notes: Composition varies with geography and plant material.

modern_information.evidence_summary: Abies webbiana is an aromatic Himalayan conifer studied for volatile constituents and traditional respiratory applications; clinical claims require preparation-specific evidence.
modern_information.safety_notes: Use authenticated material and appropriate preparation.
